title: Config dialog text appears blurry/low-definition compared to rest of UI
author: bruste77
body_snippet:
**Version**: Nightly Build — 20260804 (v1.82.0)

**Environment**:
Windows 10/11

Reproducible especially on HiDPI/fractional scaling (125%, 150%, mixed DPI monitors)

**Observed**:
Text in the Config panel (connection properties grid) appears softer/blurry (low-defined) than text in the rest of the UI.

**Expected**:
Text rendering quality in Config panel should match the rest of the application and appear crisp.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Your suspected root cause was right, and the fix is exactly the one you pointed at.

`ConfigWindow.cs` set `UseCompatibleTextRendering = true` on the property grid. That routes text through GDI+ `Graphics.DrawString`, which renders without ClearType. Everything else in the app paints through GDI/`TextRenderer`, because startup calls `Application.SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault(false)` — so this grid was the single control opting back out of the crisp path.
